claim: Chainalysis projects on-chain stablecoin transaction counts could match Visa and Mastercard's off-chain transaction counts only between 2031 and 2039 — outside the reader's 2-5 year window.
scope_conditions: Chainalysis's own projection model, published April 2026, industry-interested source
quoted_support: Stablecoin payment volumes are on pace to match Visa and Mastercard's off-chain transaction volumes somewhere between 2031 and 2039, putting direct competitive pressure on legacy payment rails.

claim: Stablecoins processed $28 trillion in adjusted (noise-filtered) real economic volume in 2025, having grown at a 133% CAGR since 2023.
quoted_support: Adjusted volume has grown at a 133% compound annual growth rate since 2023, reaching $28 trillion in real economic activity in 2025.

claim: An estimated $80-100 trillion in wealth will move from Baby Boomers to Millennials/Gen Z between 2028 and 2048, a demographic cited as accelerating crypto-native payment adoption.
scope_conditions: Merrill Lynch wealth-transfer estimate, cited by Chainalysis
quoted_support: Merrill Lynch estimates that by 2048, up to $100 trillion in wealth could pass from Boomers to their children and grandchildren.
